items.title: 2026-018: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP
items.summary: CERT-EU advisory on two critical PHP flaws allowing unauthenticated RCE, fixed in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35; PoCs are circulating and exploitation is considered likely.

items.title: 2026-019: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions
